query: SEO audit dfp.facilitron.com for the query set 'district facility rental software, school facility scheduling'. Why isn't it ranking?
expected_behavior: Fetches the page and inspects on-page + technical signals (title/meta/H1, heading structure, schema, canonical, internal links, image alt, indexability, Core Web Vitals)
Folds in the sibling audits where relevant (tron:site-audit for perf, tron:a11y-scan for a11y, tron:link-check for links) rather than re-deriving them
Ties every finding to the target query set and returns a prioritized fix list, not a flat dump
Stays git-free: it diagnoses and writes the audit, and hands the actual page edits to a git user rather than branching or committing
